correctness.rationale: Comparison of cyclic closed neighborhoods gives necessary/sufficient omitted-vertex conditions: no pair i,i+3 and no three consecutive omitted vertices. In C11 omitted sets of size5 are all 11 maximum independent sets of the step-three cycle and fail domination; 55 independent omitted 4sets form five rotation orbits, exactly three valid. Representative move tables give 11 frozen and a C22 slide component, plus connected 4-regular jump graph. Direct independent complete code enumeration n=4..11 reproduces every minimum size and slide component and verifies jump 66 edges; exact BFS of 33 states proves radius4/diameter5. Statements are bounded to n<=11 cutoff and C11 structure.
